content.text: You’re a creator in Kenya. You’ve written an ebook. You’re ready to sell it globally. But Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad don’t operate here. Conventional platforms lock you out. This guide solves that. You’ll deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-3|The Full]] and blockchain payments. No platform dependencies. No geographic restrictions. Full ownership. By the end, you’ll have a live store accepting crypto payments from anywhere, delivering products instantly, and storing your data securely. This isn’t a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure built to withstand the exact [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-4|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-actually-16|financial]] isolation you face.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Cloudflare’s global edge network and blockchain payments remove geographic barriers entirely. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store for free, while Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without servers. USDT on Tron settles payments in under 60 seconds for fees under $0.10. Binance P2P lets you convert crypto to Kenyan shillings instantly. This stack is designed for regions where conventional payment processors fail. It’s not a patch—it’s a complete system. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform can shut you down or restrict your access.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need three things: a Cloudflare account (free), a NOWPayments account (no KYC), and your ebook files. Cloudflare provides the hosting and backend. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery. If you’re in Kenya, use Binance P2P to convert crypto earnings to shillings. This stack requires no technical expertise—just follow the steps. Everything is documented in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) if you want to skip setup entirely.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by creating a NOWPayments account. Set USDT on Tron as your default currency for low fees and fast settlement. Connect your Cloudflare account to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate order processing. Store orders in Google Sheets or Supabase. Configure webhooks to trigger file delivery from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 the moment payment confirms. Test the pipeline with a small transaction. Ensure the ebook delivers instantly. This system is modular—each component works independently but integrates seamlessly.
Cloudflare’s edge network serves your store globally with zero latency.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages. Share the live URL with your audience. When a buyer sends USDT, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and fires a webhook. Your backend script checks the transaction, logs the order, and sends the ebook download link. The entire process takes seconds. Monitor your first transactions through Google Sheets or Supabase. Once you confirm the system works, scale your marketing. This stack is designed to handle thousands of transactions without additional setup.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Add more products by uploading files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and updating your backend logic. Use Cloudflare’s edge network to serve your store globally with zero latency. Convert crypto earnings to shillings via Binance P2P. If you’re ready to build additional stacks, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. This infrastructure scales with you—no platform limits, no revenue caps. You’re not renting a store; you’re owning a system.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Creators in Africa can sell digital products globally using Cloudflare infrastructure and blockchain payments. Host your store on Cloudflare Pages, process payments with NOWPayments (0.5% fee), and deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. USDT on Tron ensures under $0.10 fees and 60-second settlement. Binance P2P converts crypto to local currency. This stack works in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and beyond—no Stripe or PayPal required.
USDT on Tron settles payments in under 60 seconds for fees under $0.10.

If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, or the Philippines, this same infrastructure applies. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for instant deployment. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to download. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, or templates, this stack removes geographic barriers entirely. Cloudflare’s edge network and blockchain payments give you global reach without platform restrictions.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a Cloudflare account. Sign up for NOWPayments and set USDT on Tron as your currency. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages. Configure webhooks to connect NOWPayments to your backend. Test the pipeline with a small transaction. Monitor orders in Google Sheets or Supabase. Convert earnings to local currency via Binance P2P. Scale by adding more products and updating your backend.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates. Deploy in 48 hours with no coding required. Everything is documented for non-technical creators.
What if crypto prices fluctuate?
USDT is a stablecoin pegged to the US dollar. Its value remains consistent. Convert earnings to local currency immediately via Binance P2P to avoid volatility.
How do I handle refunds?
Issue refunds manually by sending crypto back to the buyer’s wallet. Document your refund policy clearly on your store. This system gives you full control over transactions.
Can I sell to buyers in the US or Europe?
Yes. This stack accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies globally. Buyers in any country can purchase your products using USDT, BTC, or ETH.
What happens if Cloudflare or NOWPayments goes down?
Your store remains live because Cloudflare’s edge network is distributed globally. NOWPayments operates on-chain, independent of any single platform. Your infrastructure is resilient by design.
Binance P2P converts crypto earnings to local currency instantly.
